title: Plan the V4 IFX Profile validation program
goal: Plan a fail-closed V4-TODO-001/002/003 program using immutable V4 1.1.0 as its initial baseline, versioned 1.1.x fixes, an in-repository guard installation and external mutable roots without authorizing implementation or cutover.
acceptanceCriteria: The plan records the immutable 1.1.0 release identity, archive hash and canonical source authority.
The guard installation topology preserves a read-only D:/IFX TargetRoot and keeps StateRoot and EvidenceRoot outside it.
The absence of a package-external Profile installer in 1.1.0 is an explicit P10.0/P10.1 compatibility gate, never bypassed by editing the installed package.
V4-TODO-001, V4-TODO-002 and V4-TODO-003 have ordered checkpoints, evidence requirements and stop conditions.
Every V4 baseline correction found during testing requires a certified, published and freshly installed 1.1.x patch.
Remote workflow or ruleset mutation, IFX cutover, legacy retirement, guard directory creation and Profile implementation remain outside this planning checkpoint.
